subject: Implementation discount & onboarding SRE credits for Medicta VPC deployment
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@medicta.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@medicta.com>, Procurement <procure@medicta.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medicta VPC terms — implementation credits?

Hi Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks for the earlier call. We're excited to move forward with Redwood Private (VPC) for our inference platform. Before we execute, procurement has two asks that are blocking our PO:

1) Implementation/onboarding discount: Medicta will be handling a lot of the infra work but we need a partial implementation credit to offset our professional services budget. Can Redwood provide a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first 3 invoices? We're thinking in the range of $45k–$60k given the scope (multi-region staging + audit support).

2) Success SLA / SRE credits: As a regulated healthcare customer, we need a guaranteed escalation path during the first 90 days post-launch. Would you be open to providing a limited pool of SRE credits (e.g., 40 hours) at no charge for remediation and runbook hardening?

We're flexible on whether the onboarding credit shows as an invoice line item or a prepaid credit, but procurement prefers a clear amortization schedule. If you can share an example structure (numbers, duration, how credits are drawn down) we'll take that to legal and procurement.

I've attached a short SOW draft and our security addendum for reference.

[Attachment: Medicta_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Medicta_Security_Addendum.docx (DOCX)]

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our board has asked us to close by end of month.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform & DevOps
Medicta Health
alice.chen@medicta.com

--- original call notes pasted below for context ---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@medicta.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medicta VPC terms — implementation credits?

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the SOW + addendum. We're excited to partner with Medicta. High-level responses below and then two concrete packaging options so procurement has something to review quickly.

Short answers:
- Implementation/onboarding credit: yes — we can provide a one-time onboarding credit but the size depends on committed term and support tier.
- SRE credits (90-day success window): we can grant an initial pool of complimentary SRE hours for runbook verification and post-launch remediation if we land on a 12‑month committed deployment.

Two proposal options (numbers are draft, can be refined):

Option A — Standard Commit (12 mo)
- Dedicated VPC nodes + Platform fee (annualized): $420k/year
- One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 applied across first 3 invoices (line-item: Onboarding Credit)
- Complimentary SRE hours: 30 hrs during first 90 days
- Support tier: Business, 24x5, 4-hr P1 SLAs

Option B — Anchor Commit (24 mo, deeper discount)
- Dedicated VPC nodes + Platform fee (annualized): $760k/yr (billed annually)
- One-time onboarding credit: $60,000 applied as prepaid credit amortized monthly over first 6 months
- Complimentary SRE hours: 60 hrs during first 90 days + 8 extended-response engineering sessions for runbook pairing
- Support tier: Premium, 24x7, 2-hr P1 SLAs + quarterly review calls

Operational notes:
- Credits drawdown: we propose a simple ledger where engineering tickets are billed against the SRE credit pool. Any overage is billed at standard hourly rates.
- Security addendum: we'll accept customer-provided SAML/SCIM + KMS; our security team will review your addendum and propose a single addendum redline.

Next steps: if any of these are broadly acceptable, I can loop in Marissa to document in a term sheet and Rishi to model the final economics. If procurement prefers a specific amortization cadence or needs the onboarding credit capitalized on your side, let me know and we'll adapt.

Thanks — available tomorrow for a 30-min sync to finalize.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Success — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[sent from mobile]

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — Option B looks closer to what our finance committee will sign off on, but two small changes we'd like to request:

1) Move the $60k onboarding credit to be explicitly shown as a prepayment credit on the contract (line: "Onboarding Prepaid Credit"), amortized monthly over the first 6 months. Procurement requires this for their ledger.

2) Clarify the SRE credit consumption process in the SOW: we want an explicit ticket-to-credit mapping and a named escalation contact for severity 1 incidents. Can you add an appendix to the SOW showing example ticket pulls and a sample runbook verification checklist?

If you can update the SOW with those two items and provide a DocuSign link, we can get an internal PO raised this week.

Also — if Redwood can provide a one-time 10% discount on the first annual invoice (as part of the Anchor Commit), that will help us land the board approval. Not a dealbreaker but helpful.

I've attached a lightly edited version of the SOW with comments.

Thanks,
Alice

[Attachment: Medicta_SOW_v1_annotated.pdf (PDF)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Medicta VPC terms — implementation credits?

Looping internal approvers — thread below.

Quick summary:
- Customer (Medicta) prefers Option B (24 mo anchor) with onboarding prepaid credit shown on contract, and asks for a 10% one‑time discount on the first annual invoice.
- They also want SRE credit governance spelled out in the SOW (ticket mapping + escalation contact).

Rishi — can you run final margin + risk on: (a) $60k onboarding credit amortized over 6 months, (b) 10% on first-year invoice (we can limit to invoice 1 only), (c) 60 hours complimentary SRE in first 90 days? Please include recommended guardrails (e.g., max ticket complexity, out-of-scope work rates).

David — if we sign, finance will need invoice wording for the prepaid credit and suggested amortization lines. Can you draft the invoice line items we would accept? We want to keep procurement happy but not create an open liability.

Happy to take the small discount to secure the deal if Rishi confirms economics. Hannah — please update SOW with the appendix (ticket mapping + escalation contact) and prepare DocuSign draft.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
